ApiBaseUrl.Name: API Base URL
ApiBaseUrl.Hint: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible API. The guided AI Provider Setup supplies presets for DeepSeek, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, and LM Studio.

ApiKey.Name: API Key
ApiKey.Hint: API key for the current API Base URL. It stays in this browser and is never synced to the world or other users. Manage it through AI Provider Setup, which masks the value and authorizes it only for the displayed endpoint. Leave blank for a keyless local server such as Ollama or LM Studio.

Model.Name: Model
Model.Hint: Model identifier, e.g. deepseek-v4-flash, deepseek-v4-pro, gpt-5.6-luna, or any model your provider offers.

Temperature.Name: Creativity (temperature)
Temperature.Hint: Higher values give more creative (and less predictable) concepts. Grounding and selection operations always use temperature 0 for reliable local-model output.

MaxTokens.Name: Max response tokens
MaxTokens.Hint: Global upper limit for AI responses. Each operation applies a smaller production-safe cap where possible; reasoning is disabled so the allowance is reserved for complete structured output.

RequestTimeout.Name: Request timeout (seconds)
RequestTimeout.Hint: Abort a generation if the AI provider sends no data for this long. Responses are streamed, so slow models keep working as long as data keeps arriving — this only catches genuinely stalled connections.

FreeArchetype.Name: Free Archetype variant rule
FreeArchetype.Hint: Free Archetype is not yet available for complete one-click characters at level 2 or higher: its feat prerequisites need staged validation.

ProviderSetup.Title: AI Provider Setup
ProviderSetup.MenuHint: Choose a saved connection or add another OpenAI-compatible endpoint, then save and authorize it.
ProviderSetup.Intro: Save named connections for each endpoint, then switch which one generation uses. Local servers must be running before testing or generation.
ProviderSetup.ConnectionsHint: Switching loads that connection's URL, model, and key. Save first to keep edits on the current connection.
ProviderSetup.DeleteConfirm: Delete the saved connection "{name}"? This does not affect other connections.
ProviderSetup.LocalServerHint: Ollama: add {origin} to OLLAMA_ORIGINS. LM Studio: enable CORS (Developer → Server Settings, or lms server start --cors) and authentication. An HTTPS Foundry page cannot call an HTTP provider.
ProviderSetup.BaseUrlHint: The OpenAI-compatible API root (normally ending in /v1) or a full /chat/completions endpoint.
ProviderSetup.ModelHint: Use Load Models for IDs exposed by the saved provider, or enter an exact ID manually. LM Studio lists loaded models unless Just-In-Time loading is enabled.
ProviderSetup.ModelsLoaded: Loaded {count} available model IDs. Choose one from the Model field.
ProviderSetup.ModelsEmpty: The provider returned no model IDs. For LM Studio, load a model or enable Just-In-Time loading; otherwise enter the exact ID manually.
ProviderSetup.ModelsInvalid: The provider's model-list response was not valid JSON.
ProviderSetup.ApiKeySaved: A key is saved — leave blank to keep it
ProviderSetup.ApiKeyOptional: Leave blank for a keyless local server
ProviderSetup.ApiKeyHint: Changing endpoints clears the old saved key unless you enter a replacement here.
ProviderSetup.Privacy: Each connection's key stays in this browser and is sent only to the exact endpoint authorized when you save that connection.
ProviderSetup.InvalidBaseUrl: Enter a complete HTTP or HTTPS API Base URL.
ProviderSetup.SavedAuthorized: Saved {provider} with model {model}; the key is authorized for this endpoint.
ProviderSetup.SavedNeedsKey: Saved {provider} with model {model}, but this remote provider still needs an API key.

Generator.Title: SimplyPF2e — Generator
Generator.NpcPromptPlaceholder: e.g. A calculating river pirate captain protecting her crew from a rival gang...
Generator.RandomTooltip: Random creature: ignores the description and invents something at this level. Every click rolls a new surprise.
Generator.RandomNpcTooltip: Random NPC: ignores the description and invents someone at this level. Every click rolls a new surprise.
Generator.RandomEncounterTooltip: Random encounter: ignores the theme and invents a new one at this party level. Every click rolls a new surprise.
Generator.RandomCharacterTooltip: Random character: ignores the description and invents an adventurer at this level. Every click rolls a new surprise.
Generator.EncounterThemePlaceholder: e.g. A smuggler ring run by wererats beneath the fish market... (leave blank for a surprise)
Generator.CharacterPromptPlaceholder: e.g. A gruff dwarven artillerist who left the family forge to hunt the beast that killed her mentor...
Generator.RarityCapTooltip: Excludes ancestries, backgrounds, and heritages rarer than this from what the AI can pick — e.g. capping at Uncommon rules out Rare/Unique options like Fetchling or Duskwalker
Generator.TreasureReadoutTooltip: Total loot value across all members vs. the treasure budget (per-creature budget × count, from the GM Core Treasure by Level table)
Generator.ChoicesNeedInput: Some character choices could not be selected automatically. Complete any PF2e choice dialogs to continue.
Generator.RerollLootTooltip: Generate different loot without changing the creature
Generator.NoSupportedClasses: No supported complete-only player-character classes are available in the enabled compendium sources.
Generator.FreeArchetypeUnsupported: Free Archetype at level 2 or higher needs staged feat-prerequisite validation, so complete one-click character generation is unavailable while that variant is enabled.
Generator.ReviewHint: These features had no recorded choice after creation. Some may be conditional or intentionally disabled; review them in Foundry. This snapshot does not refresh when you edit the character and is not a full character validation.
Generator.ReviewIncomplete: Not every item could be inspected. Review the character manually.
Generator.ReviewCreated: Created actor "{name}". Review the character report in the generator.
Generator.ReviewUnavailable: The character is no longer available in this world.
Generator.CreatedPresentationFailed: The character was created, but its sheet or review could not be displayed. Open it from the Actors directory; do not create it again.
Generator.NoApiKey: No API key is configured for this remote provider. Set one in Module Settings → SimplyPF2e, or use a keyless local Ollama/LM Studio endpoint.
Generator.ApiKeyNotAuthorized: Stored API key is not authorized for the current API Base URL and will not be sent.
Generator.ApiKeyAuthorized: API key authorized for the current endpoint.
Generator.ApiKeyAuthorizationFailed: The API endpoint changed before authorization completed. Review it and try again.
Generator.SourcesMissing: Required compendium content is unavailable: {categories}. Configure Compendium Sources before generating.
Generator.EmptyHint: Nothing generated yet — describe a concept above and press Generate. The preview appears here before anything is created.

Presets.FlavorGuide: Standard class presets are flavor guides only. Complete one-click Character generation still finishes Fighter, Rogue, and Investigator — Magus, Witch, and the other Standard classes do not unlock that path.
Presets.SaveTooltip: Save a custom preset (edits the selected custom preset in place)
Presets.DuplicateTooltip: Duplicate the selected preset into a new custom preset
Presets.DialogNamePlaceholder: e.g. Gunslinger, Swamp Witch, Undead Brute
Presets.DialogGuidancePlaceholder: e.g. Build like a gunslinger: a ranged duelist with extreme attack, a jam-prone firearm strike with fatal d10, low HP, high Reflex, and a quick-draw signature ability. No spellcasting.
Presets.DeleteConfirm: Delete the custom preset "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
Presets.ManageEmpty: No custom presets yet. Save one from the generator window.

Skills.PreferenceHint: Concept preferences first; remaining skills use key-ability defaults. The module assigns training and legal increases after checking native character data.
Skills.Automatic: Automatic defaults: key-ability skills first, then alphabetical order.
Skills.Snapshot: This creation snapshot does not refresh after character edits and is not a full character validation.
Skills.NativeData: Some native skill data could not be inspected. Review training and increases manually.
Skills.TrainingData: The class training allowance or native Intelligence value is unavailable. No additional training was guessed.
Skills.Schedule: The class skill-increase schedule is missing or invalid. No replacement schedule was guessed.
Skills.GrantTiming: Review native skill-grant timing, overlapping feat grants, and feat prerequisites manually. Earlier increases do not assume uncertain ranks were already available; duplicate native feat grants are not automatically reassigned.
Skills.IntelligenceTiming: Training beyond the verified first-level Intelligence allowance is available at the creation level only. Earlier increases do not assume those skills were already trained.
Skills.NativeRule: A native rule changes skill ranks in a way the allocator cannot safely reconcile. Existing choices were preserved; review these skills manually.
Skills.UnspentTraining: {count} additional training choices could not be assigned safely.
Skills.UnspentIncreases: {count} skill increases could not be assigned safely.

Loadout.NativeData: The finished character's equipment data could not be inspected. Review worn and held items manually.
Loadout.UntrainedArmor: An untrained armor item was left stowed.
Loadout.ArmorConflict: Only one selected armor item can be worn; another was left stowed.
Loadout.UntrainedWeapon: An untrained weapon was left stowed.
Loadout.HandConflict: A held item exceeded the two-hand limit and was left stowed.
Loadout.ManualAmmo: A reloadable weapon needs its ammunition loaded with the native PF2e sheet control.
Loadout.MissingAmmo: A ready ranged weapon has no compatible generated ammunition selected.

Progress.Label: Generation progress
Progress.ApplyingCharacter: Preparing and applying PF2e features. Complete any PF2e choice dialogs to continue.
Progress.Thinking: {step}: the model is thinking… (~{tokens} tokens of reasoning)
Progress.ThinkingExact: {step}: the model is thinking… ({tokens} tokens of reasoning)

Sources.MenuHint: Choose which compendium packs SimplyPF2e draws abilities, spells, feats, and equipment from.
Sources.Title: Compendium Sources
Sources.Hint: SimplyPF2e scanned this world's Item compendiums. Choose the packs each category may draw from; homebrew and module packs work too. Leaving a category empty uses the PF2e system defaults.
Sources.NonePacksFound: No compendium packs with matching content were found in this world.
Sources.ResetDone: Compendium sources reset to the PF2e system defaults.

Preview.PCSignaturePlan: Planned signature choices: {selected}/{total}. Choices are rechecked against real spells during creation; missing or rejected choices stay regular and need manual review.
Preview.PCBaseSpellPlan: Base spell plan only: prepared classes prepare each listed pick; spontaneous classes learn it at the listed rank. Review empty slots, signature spells, and restricted subclass or feat bonuses (such as curriculum or divine font) in Foundry.
Preview.PCVariableSpellPlan: Base spell plan only. Verify the tradition against your bloodline or patron; if none was selected, configure spellcasting in Foundry. Review empty slots, signature spells, subclass-granted spells, and feat bonuses after creation.
Preview.PCApproximateSpellPlan: This class has no verified casting profile yet. Spellcasting uses a generic spontaneous approximation; review casting mode, tradition, slots, and spells in Foundry before play.
Preview.FromCompendium: Pulled from the PF2e bestiary ability glossary
Preview.NotFound: No compendium match found — this entry will be skipped
Preview.EquipmentCustom: No compendium match found — this will be created as a custom gear item at the AI's estimated price
Preview.LootCustom: No compendium match found — this will be created as a custom treasure item at the AI's estimated value

ItemForge.Title: SimplyPF2e — Item Forge
ItemForge.PromptPlaceholder: e.g. A charred iron circlet that shields the wearer's mind and lets them see in the dark...
ItemForge.NoEffects: No usable passive effects survived validation — the item will be created as flavor-only. Regenerate for a mechanical version.
ItemForge.Created: Created item "{name}". Drag it from the Items directory onto a character sheet.
ItemForge.CreateFailed: Foundry did not return a created item. The preview is still available to retry.
ItemForge.CreatedPresentationFailed: The item was created, but its sheet could not be displayed. Open it from the Items directory; do not create it again.
ItemForge.NoExemplars: No rule exemplars could be harvested from this world's compendiums — is the PF2e equipment compendium installed?
ItemForge.KindsUnavailable: No supported published passive effects match this level and rarity for: {kinds}. These effect kinds are not offered.
ItemForge.MacroFailed: The item was saved, but its activation macro could not be completed. Its passive effects remain; check the console before using the activated power.
ItemForge.KindWeaponHint: A real weapon with level-appropriate runes
ItemForge.NoBaseItems: No {kind} items were found in this world's compendiums — is the PF2e equipment compendium installed?
ItemForge.NoPotencyAvailable: Item level {level} is too low for a magic {kind} — the +1 potency rune itself requires item level {minLevel}. Raise the item level.
ItemForge.EmptyHint: Nothing forged yet — describe a magic item above and press Generate. The preview appears here before the item is created.

Loot.CustomItem: Generated by SimplyPF2e. No compendium match was found for this item, so it stands in as treasure with an estimated value — replace it with the real item if you have it.

Equipment.CustomItem: Generated by SimplyPF2e. No compendium match was found for this item, so it stands in as plain gear at an estimated price — replace it with the real item if you have it.

Errors.GMOnly: Only a GM can use SimplyPF2e generation and provider setup.
Errors.NoBaseUrl: No API base URL is configured in the module settings.
Errors.NoModel: No model identifier is configured. Set one in Module Settings → SimplyPF2e before generating.
Errors.MixedContentProvider: This Foundry page uses HTTPS, but the configured AI provider uses HTTP. Browsers block that mixed-content request. Serve the provider over HTTPS or open Foundry over HTTP on the same trusted local network.
Errors.ApiError: The AI provider returned an error ({status}): {detail} {hint}
Errors.ProviderError: The AI provider reported an error: {detail}
Errors.ApiAuthHint: Check the API key, then use AI Provider Setup to authorize it for this exact endpoint.
Errors.ApiNotFoundHint: Check the API Base URL and exact model identifier; this server may not expose the expected OpenAI-compatible route.
Errors.ApiRateLimitHint: Wait and retry, or check the provider account's quota and billing status.
Errors.ApiServerHint: The provider is unavailable or failed internally; retry shortly or check its server logs/status page.
Errors.ApiRequestHint: Check the endpoint, model identifier, and provider compatibility settings.
Errors.NetworkError: Could not reach the AI provider: {message}. If you are using a local or self-hosted provider, make sure it allows requests from Foundry (CORS).
Errors.InvalidResponse: The provider returned a response that was not valid OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions JSON. Check the API Base URL and provider compatibility mode.
Errors.EmptyResponse: The AI provider returned an empty response. This was retried once already — check the provider's status page and your model name.
Errors.ReasoningWithoutJson: The AI returned reasoning but no JSON in the message content. Try generating again, disable extra reasoning, or use a model that puts JSON in the content field.
Errors.Truncated: The AI ran out of tokens before finishing its answer ({max} allowed). Try a model with efficient structured output or shorten the prompt; raise "Max response tokens" only when it is below this operation's safety cap.
Errors.Timeout: The AI provider sent no data for {seconds} seconds and the request was aborted. Check the model name and provider status. For a local model, make sure it is loaded and the server is not busy; then retry or raise the timeout in module settings.
Errors.BadJson: The AI response was not valid JSON. Try generating again.
Errors.BadStructure: The AI response was incomplete ({detail}). Try a stronger structured-output model or generate again.
Errors.NoBestiaryScaffold: No usable NPC actor was available in the enabled Bestiary Actor sources. Check Compendium Sources and try again.
Errors.WrongSystem: SimplyPF2e requires the Pathfinder Second Edition (pf2e) game system.
